scientificStatus: Numerical anticoherence verification, with interval root-preservation checks for serialized coefficients. No exact AC existence or maximality proof is inferred.
method: Independent direct binomial reduced-state sum; exact serialized pole-zero checks; interval Taylor/Rouche root disks in two stereographic charts.

packagedInputEquivalence.note: The packaged observations file has sanitized provenance paths; all fields consumed by verify_refinement.py are identical to the audited input.
